column3: kāvyaṃ tu jāyate jātu kasyacit pratibhāvataḥ ||
āsta eva nirātaṅkaṃ kāntaṃ kāvyamayaṃ vapuḥ ||
ruṇaddhi rodasī cāsya yāvat kīrtir anaśvarī |
tāvat kilāyam adhyāste sukṛtī vaibudhaṃ padam ||
ato .bhivāñchatā kīrtiṃ stheyasīm ā bhuvaḥ sthiteḥ |
supāṃ tiṅāṃ ca vyutpattiṃ vācāṃ vāñchantyalaṃkṛtim ||
śabdārthau sahitau kāvyaṃ gadyaṃ padyaṃ ca taddvidhā |
sargabandho mahākāvyaṃ mahatāṃ ca mahacca yat |
vaktraṃ cāparavaktraṃ ca kāle bhāvyārthaśaṃsi ca ||
anyaiḥ svacaritaṃ tasyāṃ nāyakena tu nocyate |
tadeva ca kila jyāyaḥ sadarthamapi nāparam ||
māyeva bhadreti yathā sā cāsādhvī prakalpanā |
vijahrustasya tāḥ śokaṃ krīḍāyāṃ vikṛtaṃ ca tat ||
kathaṃ dūtyaṃ prapadyeranniti yuktyā na yujyate ||
etad grāhyaṃ surabhi kusumaṃ grāmyametannidheyaṃ dhatte śobhāṃ viracitamidaṃ sthānamasyaitadasya |
mālākāro racayati yathā sādhu vijñāya mālāṃ yojyaṃ kāvyeṣvavahitadhiyā tadvad evābhidhānam ||
sādhunā sādhunā tena rājatā rājatā bhṛtā |
sahitaṃ sahitaṃ kartuṃ saṃgataṃ saṃgataṃ janam ||
sādhuḥ saṃsārādbibhyadasmādasārāt kṛtvā kleśāntaṃ yāti vartma praśāntam |
jātiṃ vyādhīnāṃ durnayānāmadhīnāṃ vāñchan tyāyastvaṃ chinddhi muktānayastvam ||
na te dhīr dhīra bhogeṣu ramaṇīyeṣu saṃgatā |
ghanā ghanā nīlaghanāghanālakāṃ priyāmimāmutsukayanti yanti ca ||
kṛtsnaṃ ca sarvapādeṣu duṣkṛtaṃ sādhu tādṛśam ||
prasādi svabhidhānaṃ ca yamakaṃ kṛtināṃ matam ||
utsavaḥ sudhiyāmeva hanta durmedhaso hatāḥ vā ||
guṇānāṃ samatāṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpakaṃ nāma tadviduḥ ||
payomucāṃ dhvanirdhīro dunoti mama tāṃ priyām ||
sarvaṃ sarveṇa sārūpyaṃ nāsti bhāvasya kasyacit |
sādhvyaḥ svageheṣviva bhartṛhīnāḥ kekā vineśuḥ śikhināṃ mukheṣu ||
śuneva sāraṅgakulaṃ tvayā bhinnaṃ dviṣāṃ balam ||
sa pītavāsāḥ pragṛhītaśārṅgo manojñabhīmaṃ vapurāpa kṛṣṇaḥ |
śaśino grahaṇād etadādhikyaṃ kila na hy ayam |
nirdiṣṭa upameye.rthe vācyo vā jalado.tra tu ||
uktārthasya prayogo hi gurumarthaṃ na puṣyati ||
tathāpi teṣāṃ tair asti kāntir vāpyugratāpi vā ||
ākṣepa iti taṃ santaḥ śaṃsanti dvividhaṃ yathā ||
ahaṃ tvāṃ yadi nekṣeya kṣaṇamapyutsukā tataḥ |
sādhu vāsādhu vāgāmi puṃsām ātmaiva śaṃsati ||
svayaṃ kṛtair eva nidarśanairiyaṃ mayā prakﾱptā khalu vāgalaṃkṛtiḥ |
adya yā mama govinda jātā tvayi gṛhāgate |
neyaṃ virauti bhṛṅgālī madena mukharā muhuḥ |
sa ekas trīṇi jayati jaganti kusumāyudhaḥ |
haratāpi tanuṃ yasya śambhunā na hṛtaṃ balam ||
śeṣo himagiristvaṃ ca mahānto guravaḥ sthirāḥ |
kiṃcid vidhitsoryā nindā vyājastutir asau yathā ||
rāmaḥ saptābhinat sālān giriṃ krauñcaṃ bhṛgūttamaḥ |
śatāṃśenāpi bhavatā kiṃ tayoḥ sadṛśaṃ kṛtam ||

upamānena tattvaṃ ca bhedaṃ ca vadataḥ punaḥ |
kimayaṃ śaśī na sa divā virājate kusumāyudho na dhanurasya kausumam |
iti vismayādvimṛśato.pi me matistvayi vīkṣate na labhate.rthaniścayam ||
asmin jahīhi suhṛdi praṇayābhyasūyām āśliṣya gāḍham amumānatamādareṇa |
vindhyaṃ mahāniva ghanaḥ samaye.bhivarṣann ānandajair nayanavāribhirukṣatu tvām ||
tvattejasā dagdhasamastaśobhā dviṣāṃ puraḥ paśyatu rājalokaḥ ||
girāmalaṃkāravidhiḥ savistaraḥ svayaṃ viniścitya dhiyā mayoditaḥ |
atrāpi bahu vaktavyaṃ jāyate tattu noditam |
sakhi mānaṃ priye dhehi laghutāmasya mā gamaḥ |
bhartuśchandānuvartinyaḥ prema ghnanti na hi striyaḥ ||
yathāha gaccha gaccheti punaruktaṃ ca tadviduḥ ||
iṣṭaṃ niścitaye vākyaṃ na velāyeti tadyathā ||
tejas tirayataḥ sauraṃ ghanān paśya divābhitaḥ ||
pātāṃ vaḥ śambhuśarvāṇyāv iti prāhur visaṃdhyadaḥ ||
nyāyaḥ śāstraṃ trivargoktidaṇḍanītiṃ ca tāṃ viduḥ |
aho nu mandimā teṣāṃ bhaktirvā nāsti bhartari ||
hato .nena mama bhrātā mama putraḥ pitā mama |
viśeṣaṃ veda bālo.pi kaṣṭaṃ kiṃ nu kathaṃ nu tat ||
na dūṣaṇāyāyamudāhṛto vidhirna cābhimānena kimu pratīyate |
kṛtātmanāṃ tattvadṛśāṃ ca mādṛśo jano .bhisaṃdhiṃ ka ivāvabhotsyate ||
na sa śabdo na tadvācyaṃ na sa nyāyo na sā kalā |
jāyate yanna kāvyāṅgamaho bhāro mahān kaveḥ ||
jātyādyapohe vṛttiḥ kva kva viśeṣaḥ kutaśca saḥ ||
tadapoheṣu ca tathā siddhā sā buddhigocarā |
yathā śucistanuḥ straiṇī tatpramāṇāni santi vā ||
kāraṇaṃ cen na tannityaṃ nityaṃ cet kāraṇaṃ na tat ||
pituḥ priyāya yāṃ bhīṣmaścakre sā kāmabādhinī ||
jāmadagnyaṃ yudhā jitvā sā jñeyā kopabādhinī ||
ko vā gatvaramarthibhyo na yacchati dhanaṃ laghu ||
kimatyayaṃ tu yaḥ kṣepaḥ saukaryaṃ darśayatyasau |
tasyāpi sudhiyām iṣṭā doṣāḥ prāguditās trayaḥ ||
mukhaṃ padmamivetyatra kiṃ sādhyaṃ kiṃ ca sādhanam |
iti prayogasya yathā kalāv api bhavāniha |
kāvyaṃ kapitthamāmraṃ vat keṣāṃcit sadṛśaṃ yathā ||
ahighnapadmasya jalāridhāmnas tavaiva nānyasya sutasya vṛttam ||
śaṅkhavrātākulāntas timimakarakulākīrṇavīcīpratāno dadhre yasyāmbur āśiḥśaśikumudasudhākṣīraśuddhāṃ sukīrtim ||
iti nigaditāstāstā vācām alaṃkṛtayo mayā bahuvidhakṛtīrdṛṣṭvānyeṣāṃ svayaṃ paritarkya ca |
prathitavacasaḥ santo.bhijñāḥ pramāṇamihāpare gurutaradhiyām asvārādhaṃ mano.kṛtabuddhibhiḥ ||
tasya cādhigame yatnaḥ kāryaḥ kāvyaṃ vidhitsatā |
parapratyayato yattu kriyate tena kā ratiḥ ||
nānyapratyayaśabdā vāg [... au4 Zeichenjh] mude satām |
varṇānāṃ kramavṛttitvān nyāyyā nāpi ca saṃhatiḥ ||
tasmāt kūṭastha ityeṣā śābdī vaḥ kalpanā vṛthā |
vinaśvaro.stu nityo vā sambandho.rthena vā satā |
namo.stu tebhyo vidvadbhyaḥ pramāṇaṃ ye.sya niścitau ||
janako gavi gobuddher mṛgyatām aparo dhvaniḥ ||
ke śabdāḥ kiṃ ca tadvācyamityaho vartma dustaram ||
vakravācāṃ kavīnāṃ ye prayogaṃ prati sādhavaḥ |
śrotrādiṃ na tu durbodhaṃ na duṣṭādimapeśalam |
tam ādriyeta prāyeṇa na tu yogavibhāgajam ||
sarūpaśeṣaṃ tu pumān striyā yatra ca śiṣyate |
